{{Top}}
[[File:Clone_Carrying_a_DN_Bolt_Caster.png|thumb|right|200px|A [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] carrying a bolt caster on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]]]
A '''plasma disruptor''' was a type of electrical weapon that utilized [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] to disrupt or overload the circuitry of a machine or [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. Depending on how this is used, a plasma disruptor can be either a tool using for breaching doors or disabling security devices or an effective weapon used against both droids and organics alike.

[[Drever Corporation]] was a known manufacturer of plasma disruptors, including the "[["DN bolt caster" plasma disruptor|DN bolt caster]]" and its predecessor, the "[["Phoenix II" plasma disruptor|Phoenix II]]."
